known.title: Functional: Forge releases lose their cut and Windows instructions
Functional: The required-test list makes Forge full runs fail

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 1, Harm 4
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a maintainer runs the required full suite on main before a Forge release.
The new entry is copied into a temporary client by `tests/test_required_repo_rules.py:45`, but that test creates files only for the six previous entries at `tests/test_required_repo_rules.py:37`. Its four cases therefore pass the new, nonexistent test path to pytest through `src/forge/fasttest.py:860`, causing pytest to fail. The scheduled and manual full-suite workflow runs these cases, so it cannot produce the green result required to push a release tag. Update the fixture and its expectations to include the new required test.
findings.title: Functional: The required-test list makes Forge full runs fail

why: Main is red: the daily-release-cut fix (4b5a40b0a) rewrote the client skill paragraph 'After the last product merge for a release or sign-off, start the full run at once with gh workflow run forge.yml --ref <default>...' although the daily cut is a rule for Forge's own releases only; tests/test_full_run_starts_before_notes.py::test_1 fails on every pull request, and the combined CI of the train that merged it did not select that test
